name: Acrobatics
description: Leaping, tumbling, balancing, and staying upright on narrow or unstable surfaces while moving with speed and precision.

name: Animal Handling
description: Calming beasts, reading their moods, guiding mounts, and predicting how animals react to danger or commands.

name: Arcana
description: Identifying magical effects, understanding spellcasting, interpreting mystical symbols, and recalling lore about the Weave and planar phenomena.

name: Athletics
description: Climbing, swimming, jumping, grappling, shoving, and overcoming physical obstacles with strength, speed, or endurance.

name: Deception
description: Lying, bluffing, disguising your true intentions, and misleading others through falsehoods, charm, or misdirection.

name: History
description: Recalling the deeds of rulers, wars, cultures, magical artifacts, and ancient events from the distant past.

name: Insight
description: Reading body language, sensing lies, judging a creature's motives, and determining whether someone is being honest or deceitful.

name: Intimidation
description: Using a threatening presence, harsh words, or physical menace to frighten, coerce, or cow a creature into compliance.

name: Investigation
description: Searching for clues, examining objects for hidden details, noticing patterns, and analyzing a scene for signs of danger or deceit.

name: Medicine
description: Treating wounds, diagnosing illness, stabilizing dying creatures, and understanding how injuries and poisons affect the body.

name: Nature
description: Understanding the behavior of plants, animals, weather, terrain, and natural environments across the wilderness.

name: Perception
description: Noticing movement, sounds, hidden objects, distant threats, and subtle clues in the environment before others do.

name: Performance
description: Entertaining an audience through music, dance, acting, poetry, and other artistic expression.

name: Persuasion
description: Influencing others through charm, diplomacy, good judgment, and calm argument to gain cooperation or goodwill.

name: Religion
description: Understanding gods, holy symbols, sacred rites, faith traditions, and the history of divine magic and the undead.

name: Sleight of Hand
description: Quick, precise manipulation of objects, pickpocketing, concealment, and performing fine motor tasks while under pressure.

name: Stealth
description: Moving quietly, hiding from notice, staying unseen, and evading detection by enemies or bystanders.

name: Survival
description: Tracking creatures, navigating the wilderness, finding shelter and food, and identifying hazards in harsh environments.

name: Alchemist's Supplies
description: Creating acid, alchemist's fire, potions, smoke sticks, and neutralizers.

name: Brewer's Supplies
description: Brewing ale, evaluating the quality of alcohol, or drinking someone under the table.

name: Calligrapher's Supplies
description: Writing beautiful text, creating maps, or forging official signatures.

name: Carpenter's Tool
description: Building wooden structures, fortifying doors, and crafting basic wooden items.

name: Cartographer's Tool
description: Designing maps, navigating unknown terrain, and reading old charts.

name: Cobbler's Tool
description: Repairing boots, modifying shoes to hide hidden compartments, and helping the party march longer without tiring.

name: Cook's Utensils
description: Preparing meals, identifying poisoned food, and maximizing the party's health during a short rest.

name: Glassblower's Tool
description: Crafting glass vials, window panes, mirrors, and delicate decorative art.

name: Jeweler's Tool
description: Appraising gemstones, cutting jewelry, and spotting counterfeit valuables.

name: Leatherworker's Tool
description: Crafting leather armor, repairing saddles, and skinning beasts safely.

name: Mason's Tool
description: Analyzing stone walls for structural weak points, digging tunnels, and carving stone.

name: Painter's Supplies
description: Painting portraits, visual art, or drawing realistic sketches of a target from memory.

name: Potter's Tool
description: Crafting clay pots, tiles, bricks, and ceramic storage urns.

name: Smith's Tool
description: Forging and repairing metal armor, weapons, shields, and locks.

name: Tinker's Tool
description: Repairing general broken items, fixing minor machinery, and patching holes in equipment.

name: Weaver's Tool
description: Making clothes, repairing sails, crafting rope, and weaving tapestries.

name: Woodcarver's Tool
description: Crafting arrows, wooden figurines, and carving designs into staffs or bows.

name: Dice Set
description: Playing games of chance, gambling, or bluffing opponents out of their gold.

name: Dragonchess Set
description: Winning strategic, board-based games of military skill and wit.

name: Playing Card Set
description: Playing poker-style card games, performing card tricks, and bluffing.

name: Three-Dragon Ante Set
description: A specific, popular strategic card game played in taverns across the realms.

name: Bagpipes
description: Loud, wind-based instrument; great for stirring military marches or causing a distraction.

name: Drum
description: Percussion instrument; excellent for keeping a steady rhythm or sending signals over long distances.

name: Dulcimer
description: A stringed instrument played by striking the strings with small hammers.

name: Flute
description: A versatile, portable woodwind instrument capable of beautiful, quiet melodies.

name: Horn
description: A loud, brass or animal-horn instrument used for announcements or battle signals.

name: Lute
description: The classic, pear-shaped stringed instrument favored by most traveling bards.

name: Lyre
description: A small, harp-like string instrument often associated with classical music and poetry.

name: Pan Flute
description: A series of short pipes bound together, common among folk musicians and fey creatures.

name: Shawm
description: A piercing, double-reed woodwind instrument that sounds similar to an oboe.

name: Viol
description: A stringed instrument played with a bow, closely resembling a modern cello or viola.

name: Disguise Kit
description: Using cosmetics, hair dye, and prosthetics to completely alter your physical appearance.

name: Forgery Kit
description: Mimicking handwriting, replicating wax seals, and faking official documents.

name: Herbalism Kit
description: Identifying medicinal flora, gathering wild plants, and crafting Potions of Healing.

name: Navigator's Tool
description: Plotting ship courses, calculating latitude using stars, and preventing getting lost at sea.

name: Poisoner's Kit
description: Extracting toxic venom from creatures, handling dangerous chemicals, and crafting lethal poisons.

name: Thieves' Tool
description: Picking physical locks, disabling mechanical traps, and opening chests safely.

name: Vehicles (Land)
description: Driving horse-drawn carriages, carts, chariots, and wagon trains.

name: Vehicles (Water)
description: Steering rowboats, sailing ships, warships, and navigating water currents safely.

name: Simple Weapons
description: You gain proficiency in simple weapons.

name: Martial Weapons
description: You gain proficiency in martial weapons.

name: Martial Weapons (Light)
description: You gain proficiency in martial weapons with the Light property.

name: Martial Weapons (Finesse or Light)
description: You gain proficiency in martial weapons with the Finesse or Light property.

name: Firearms
description: You gain proficiency in firearms (pistols and muskets).
